searchText: > once the pq fork is active it drains them to the cl side. sounds like a disaster if we perform 800k writes during that fork transition. The current design puts the registration into a separate list in the state instead of in `Validator` container which is good. Because clients would not need to re-hash the validator list, but the registration list only. One annoying thing is to scan for duplicate XMSS key and duplicate VRF root and existing entry of validator per request.
